description: Creating a SCREEN scope node whose external_id is already used by a GROUP scope node under the same parent is still rejected with 400 Bad Request / EXTERNAL_ID_CONFLICT before the write executes: API-101 scopes external_id uniqueness by resource type ("scope-nodes", the one family tag every scope-node kind shares) and placement (same parent) — the two rows' differing `kind` (group vs. screen) plays no part in the uniqueness scope, so it is not an escape from the collision API-102 pins for two same-kind rows.

body.title: Bad Request
body.detail: external_id "lobby-screen-1" is already in use by another scope node under this parent.
